Name: Seed Maker Tweak
Author: LycheeZ
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Seed Maker Tweak modifies the Seed Maker's output quantity.
Seed Maker Tweak（种子制造机调整）修改的是游戏内[b]种子制造机[/b]的产出数量。
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (4.1.0 or later).[/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional but recommended — provides the in-game config UI).[/*]
[*]Place the SeedMakerTweak folder in your game's folder in your game's Mods/ directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. The mod works immediately with default settings (2–3 seeds).[/*]
[*]To customize: open the in-game menu (the wrench icon on the title screen or the options tab in-game), find "Seed Maker Tweak" under mod configs, and adjust the Minimum Output and Maximum Output values.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]In vanilla Stardew Valley, the Seed Maker produces [b]1–3 seeds[/b] per batch — this mod changes the default to [b]2–3 seeds[/b], giving you a more reliable and slightly more generous harvest from every crop you put in.
The output range is fully [b]configurable[/b] through the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). You can set the minimum and maximum anywhere from 1 to 10 seeds per batch.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]星露谷物语原版中，种子制造机每次投入一个农作物后产出 [b]1–3 颗种子[/b]。本 mod 将默认产出改为 [b]2–3 颗[/b]，让你的每次种子生产更加稳定、回报略高一些。
产出范围完全[b]可自定义[/b]——通过 Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）配置界面，你可以将最小值和最大值在 1 到 10 之间自由设置。 [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
1.[b]SMAPI[/b] (4.1.0 or later).
2. [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size]
